name: @aphrody/bun
description: bun:ffi bindings for the Aphrody native library (aphrody-ffi: M3 tokens, icons, SVG, render, web, X, inference) and the aphrody app-server client. Not the Bun runtime: that is the unmodified npm package `bun`.
author: aphrody-code

scripts.test: bash ../../scripts/aphrody/build/rust/cargo-serial.sh build --release --locked -p aphrody-ffi --features gpu && APHRODY_FFI_DEV=1 APHRODY_FFI_REQUIRE_NATIVE=1 bun test test-library.test.ts test-native.test.ts test-native-artifact.test.ts test-pipeline.test.ts && APHRODY_FFI_DEV=1 bun run test-ffi.ts && APHRODY_FFI_DEV=1 bun run test-cli-only.ts
